r6-loo-honesty.title: LOO covariance-honesty guard is non-tautological
r6-loo-honesty.imperative: Verify the regression guard test detects over-claiming (zstd > 1.5 when sigma too small) and that the old self-inclusive formula would fail it.
r6-loo-honesty.finding: LOO guard is non-tautological. REPL spot-check (seed=7, scatter=0.3, sigma=0.02, n=8): LOO zstd=2.12 > 1.5 (PASSES guard). Self-inclusive zstd=0.20 < 1.5 (would FAIL guard — old formula incapable of detecting over-claiming). The test_zstd_high_when_overclaiming_REGRESSION_GUARD asserts ax.zstd > 1.5 which the LOO form satisfies. Discrepancy noted: implementer claims self-inclusive ≈ 0.026; actual is 0.20 — likely different code state or DriftFit behavior on n=8 with these seeds. Not material: 0.20 still fails the > 1.5 guard. Edge cases: n=2 out-of-sample works (zstd > 1.5 for 2-point over-claim), n=1 gracefully skipped. LOO formula in _loo_z_scores is correctly: z_i = (x_i - mu_loo) / sqrt(sigma_i^2 + sigma_pred_loo^2).

Implementation in _separability(): calls fit_two_way(valid_df[val_col].astype(float).values, teams=valid_df['constructor'].values, circuits=valid_df['gp_name'].values) and extracts tw.frac_team, tw.frac_circuit, tw.frac_resid. r8-covariance-blobs.title: Real 2x2 covariance blobs used
r8-covariance-blobs.imperative: Verify param_pair_corr reads real 2x2 off-diagonal blob (cov01/sqrt(cov00*cov11)), NOT diagonal sigma.
r8-covariance-blobs.finding: Real 2x2 blobs confirmed. _compute_param_pair_corr() uses _cov_list(blob) → np.asarray → extracts c00=cov[0,0], c01=cov[0,1], c11=cov[1,1] → corr = c01/sqrt(c00*c11). NOT diagonal sigma. L1 test test_param_pair_corr_matches_analytical_formula plants [[0.0025, 0.001], [0.001, 0.0009]] → expected = 0.001/sqrt(0.0025*0.0009) = 0.6667; asserts match abs=1e-6 — PASSED. braking blob [[1.0, 0.0], [0.0, 1e-6]] → corr=0 confirmed. slow_corner_grip and fast_corner_grip share lateral_covariance blob (same off-diagonal corr returned for both).
